__broaden__.ese: ese — not (negates a past action; ülü negates present or future) [不曾] · before a converb: ese toγ̇aγdažu 'not yet counted' (as ese ögdegsen 'not given' in §6), where ülü is the usual negative of a converb
__broaden__.oγ̇orba: oγ̇or- — to go off, depart; stem unknown, Ming 去了 may also mean 'done', uncertain; past -ba (verb, past tense) [去了] · also oγ̇or- 'to let fly, send off' (Ming 放了 'let go', of a hawk or bird); past -ba
__broaden__.bi: bi — I (first-person singular pronoun; the stems na-, nama-, min- before case endings) [我] · also 'is, exists' (verb, perhaps a short form of bü-, compare bijü; Ming 有)
__broaden__.dunda: dunda — middle, in the middle of [中] · also 'half, part-way' (adverb, before a possessive: dunda keġelitei 'half-belly-having'; Ming 半孕 'half-pregnant')
__broaden__.teriġü: teriġü — head (teriġü + possessive -tü; printed teriġü,ü but the Han reads teriġütü, 'having a head, headed') [頭 (有的)] · also plain 'head' with no ending (noun; Ming 頭)
